title: Laughing Toddler, Romper Backyard Gas Meter - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An energetic, cheerful toddler in a light-colored summer romper, socks, and soft shoes giggles while standing in the backyard grass and resting a hand on an exterior residential gas meter. The house exterior behind the child features vertical board-and-batten or grooved panel siding, typical of mid-century suburban American architecture. The margin on the right bears a photofinisher imprint reading 'AUG 62' with scalloped deckled edges.
